searchText: I reinstalled the kurtosis-cli and I am on version 1.10.2 now, but I can't start the engine ``` Error: An error occurred running the pre-validation-and-run function Caused by: An error occurred creating a new Kurtosis engine client Caused by: An error occurred starting the engine with the engine existence guarantor Caused by: An error occurred guaranteeing that a Kurtosis engine is running Caused by: An error occurred launching the engine server container Caused by: An error occurred launching the engine server container with default version tag '1.10.2' Caused by: An error occurred launching the engine server container Caused by: An error occurred creating the engine using image 'kurtosistech/engine' with tag '1.10.2' and debug mode 'false' Caused by: An error occurred attempting to create logging components for engine with GUID '291229edcd104b21a189b7f26ed1645c' in Docker network with network id 'e6785646b8f004f8b6f6d52bb7888d348877b467a836bc77ac67c3e06b6a20c9'. Caused by: An error occurred getting existing logs aggregator. Caused by: An error occurred getting the logs Aggregator object using container ID '7ac5ee8c9216850ae4ebbadf900f6e619d5d0a90cdf377e1120239555c23e8cf', labels 'map[com.kurtosistech.app-id:kurtosis com.kurtosistech.container-type:kurtosis-logs-aggregator]' and the status 'running' Caused by: An error occurred getting the logs collector container's private port specs from container '7ac5ee8c9216850ae4ebbadf900f6e619d5d0a90cdf377e1120239555c23e8cf' with labels: map[com.kurtosistech.app-id:kurtosis com.kurtosistech.container-type:kurtosis-logs-aggregator] Caused by: Expected to find port specs label 'com.kurtosistech.ports' but none was found ``` can you make sure there are no running containers (use docker stop ....) and then try a docker system prune -a && docker volume prune -a? then kurtosis engine restart? this should be a clean slate Unfortunately it didn't help. I also restarted my computer but I still see the same error cc <@412614104222531604> or <@394701976077860865> ? Jihoon also had issues with docker desktop yesterday. Orbstack worked for him tho (is also what bbusa and i use) Yeah we saw these issues before I am on Linux and I don't even have Docker Desktop installed (I think) ``` systemctl --user start docker-desktop Failed to start docker-desktop.service: Unit docker-desktop.service not found. ``` whats your docker version? 26.1.3 I udated it to 28.1.1 but I still see the same error 😦 can you prune all images again, and see if you can remove any leftover random docker networks? and stop kurtosis engine first Hey, can you try the steps outlined in this issue, seems to be the same error: https://github.com/kurtosis-tech/kurtosis/issues/2709#issuecomment-2866494635 Thank you <@394701976077860865> , running `docker container stop kurtosis-logs-aggregator` followed by `docker container rm kurtosis-logs-aggregator` fixed the problem
